footer.tagline: Kiorex — real doctors, real slots, real reviews.

unavailable.title: Temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: This feature is switched off for now. Your existing appointments and data are safe and unchanged.
unavailable.awaitingBody: This service is built but has not been approved to launch yet. Your existing appointments and data are unchanged.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or was moved.

landing.title: Book a verified doctor in under two minutes.
landing.subtitle: Real slots from the clinic's own schedule, the fee upfront, and reviews only from patients who attended.

find.title: Find
find.body: Search by specialty, doctor or clinic and filter by area, fee and availability.

pick.title: Pick a time
pick.body: See the next free slots at a glance. We hold yours for five minutes while you check out.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: Know the cancellation policy first, then confirm. You get reminders before your visit.

verified.title: Verified, not just listed
verified.body: Every bookable doctor passed syndicate-number and licence checks.

slots.title: Real slots
slots.body: Slots come straight from the clinic's own system, so there are no double bookings.

reviews.title: Reviews you can believe
reviews.body: Only patients with a completed visit can review. No anonymous ratings.

fees.title: Know the fee upfront
fees.body: Fees and any deposit are shown before you book.

landing.ctaBody: Sign in with your phone number — no password to remember.

checkout.holdLabel: We're holding this time for you

checkout.consentData: I agree that Kiorex shares my name, phone number and booking details with the clinic to arrange this visit.

checkout.confirmFailed: We couldn't confirm the booking. Please try again.
checkout.timeout: The connection dropped. Nothing was charged twice — please try again.

appointment.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again or call the clinic.

review.title: Rate your visit with {{name}}
review.phiWarning: Please don't include medical details or personal information.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.managedBy: Sign-in details are managed by Kiorex Passport.

account.deleteConfirmBody: This can't be undone. Upcoming appointments will be cancelled.
account.exportFirst: Prepare a download of my data first

ai_processing.title: AI assistance
ai_processing.body: Allow AI-assisted navigation features (off unless you turn it on).

marketplace_processing.title: Marketplace data processing
marketplace_processing.body: Lets Kiorex process your details to book and manage visits.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Appointment reminders by WhatsApp, push and in-app.

record_sharing.title: Record sharing
record_sharing.body: Allow clinics to share visit summaries with your account.

emergency.title: This sounds like an emergency
emergency.body: If you or someone near you is in danger, call the ambulance now. Kiorex can't help with emergencies and won't book an appointment for them.

market.label: Country
market.notLive: Kiorex is not live in {{country}} yet. You can browse, but booking is paused until it launches.
market.noneLive: Kiorex is not live in any market yet.

mock.label: Test mode.
mock.payment: This is a sandbox payment page. No real money moves.
mock.video: This video room is a test provider. No audio or video leaves your device.
mock.messaging: Messages are written to a test inbox and are not sent.
mock.lab: Kiorly Lab is a test partner in development.
mock.pharmacy: Kiorly Pharmacy is a test partner in development.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Everything beyond booking a doctor. Services marked as awaiting approval are built but not yet switched on.
services.pharmacy: Order medicines from nearby pharmacies, for pickup or delivery.
services.lab: Book lab tests with home collection. Results arrive in your records.
services.tele: See a doctor by video from home.
services.records: Your visit summaries, prescriptions and lab results in one place.
services.waitlist: Get offered a slot when one frees up with a fully booked doctor.

whatsapp.title: Book on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Prefer chatting? You can book the same real slots by messaging Kiorex on WhatsApp.
whatsapp.s1: Send a message and choose a specialty.
whatsapp.s2: Pick a doctor and a time from the options we send.
whatsapp.s3: Confirm. You get the same confirmation and reminders as in the app.
whatsapp.privacy: Do not send symptoms or medical details in the chat. For an emergency call 123.
whatsapp.soon: The Kiorex WhatsApp number will be announced here at launch.

orders.payHint: Payment opens in a new tab. Come back here when you are done; this page updates by itself.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.intro: When a slot opens with a doctor you are waiting for, you get an offer here. Accepting holds the slot for 5 minutes so you can confirm.
waitlist.joinTitle: No free slots? Join the waitlist
waitlist.joinHint: We will offer you a slot as soon as one opens. You can leave the waitlist any time.
waitlist.window: When would you like a slot?
waitlist.joinFailed: We could not add you to the waitlist. Try again.
waitlist.onList: You are on this doctor's waitlist.
waitlist.empty: You are not on any waitlist
waitlist.emptyHint: When a doctor has no free slots, you can join their waitlist from their profile.
waitlist.waitingHint: We will notify you when a slot opens.

errors.taken: Someone else just took that slot. We will keep you on the waitlist.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

records.title: Records
records.intro: Visit summaries, prescriptions and lab results your clinics share with you, plus files you upload. Only you can see them here.
records.readOnlyTitle: Your vault is read-only right now
records.readOnlyBody: You can still view, download and delete your records. Uploading and new sharing are paused for the moment.
records.emptyHint: Records appear here after a clinic shares them with you, or when you upload a file.
records.uploadHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. The file is stored encrypted.
records.deleteBody: It is removed from your Kiorex vault. This cannot be undone.
records.noContent: No details are available for this record.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.type: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be uploaded.
errors.size: The file is too large. The maximum is {{max}}.

records.qrHint: Show this code to the pharmacist so they can verify the prescription.
records.rxIntro: A pharmacist can scan the code to check that a prescription is genuine. The code contains no personal details.
records.rxEmptyHint: Prescriptions your doctor shares appear here.
records.rxNoItems: The medicine list has not been shared with Kiorex. The code can still be verified.
records.followUpHint: We will remind you when it is time to book a follow-up.

sharing.intro: Choose what your clinics may send to your Kiorex vault. You can turn any of these off at any time.
sharing.paused: Sharing new records is paused right now. You can still turn sharing off.

VISIT_SUMMARY.title: Visit summaries
VISIT_SUMMARY.body: Let clinics send a summary after each visit.

PRESCRIPTIONS.title: Prescriptions
PRESCRIPTIONS.body: Let clinics send your prescriptions with a verification code.

LAB_RESULTS.title: Lab results
LAB_RESULTS.body: Let labs deliver results straight into your vault.

SHARE_WITH_OTHER_CLINICS.title: Share with other clinics
SHARE_WITH_OTHER_CLINICS.body: Let a clinic you choose see records from your other clinics.

sharing.revokeBody: New records will stop arriving and the copies already in your Kiorex vault for this type are deleted. Your clinic keeps its own records.

records.privacyNote: Clinical content is encrypted and never used for analytics.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy
pharmacy.intro: Order medicines from pharmacies that accept Kiorex orders. Pay with Kiorex Pay and collect or get them delivered.
pharmacy.noPharmaciesHint: Pharmacies that accept Kiorex orders will appear here.
pharmacy.searchHint: Type at least two letters to search.
pharmacy.controlled: Controlled medicines cannot be ordered online.
pharmacy.noResultsHint: Try another name or choose a different pharmacy.
pharmacy.cartReplaced: Your cart now holds items from this pharmacy only.
pharmacy.rxHint: Choose one of your prescriptions from the vault. The pharmacy verifies it before preparing your order.
pharmacy.rxNone: You have no prescriptions in your vault.
pharmacy.payNote: You pay with Kiorex Pay. Prices are confirmed by the pharmacy.

errors.generic: We could not complete that. Please try again.
errors.rx: A valid prescription is required for these items.
errors.stock: An item is no longer available.

pharmacy.rejectedTitle: The pharmacy could not fill this order
pharmacy.autoRefund: If you paid, the full amount is refunded automatically.
pharmacy.partialReview: The pharmacy filled part of this order and it is being reviewed. We will update you.
pharmacy.refundedNote: This order was cancelled. If you had paid, your refund is on its way.
pharmacy.rxInvalid: The pharmacy could not verify your prescription.
pharmacy.cancelPaid: You have paid, so the full amount will be refunded automatically.
pharmacy.cancelUnpaid: You have not paid yet, so nothing is charged.
pharmacy.cancelTooLate: The pharmacy already started preparing this order, so it can no longer be cancelled.

lab.title: Lab tests
lab.intro: Book lab tests with home collection or at the lab. Results are delivered into your records.
lab.sameLab: A booking can include tests from one lab only. Your selection was reset.
lab.pickHint: Choose one or more tests to continue.
lab.homeUnavailable: Home collection is not available for every selected test.
lab.payNote: You pay with Kiorex Pay. The lab receives your order after payment.

errors.generic: We could not complete that. Please try again.
errors.slot: That time was just taken. Please choose another.

lab.rejectedTitle: The lab could not accept this booking
lab.resultReadyBody: It was delivered into your records.

tele.title: Video visits
tele.intro: See a doctor by video. Book a video visit, then join from here when the room opens, 15 minutes before the start.
tele.emergency: Video visits are not for emergencies. In an emergency call 123.
tele.noSessionsHint: Book a visit with a video-enabled doctor below.
tele.eligibleTitle: Confirmed visits you can make a video visit
tele.eligibleHint: Create a video session for a visit you have already booked.
tele.privacy: Only the schedule and duration of the call are stored, never the conversation.

errors.generic: We could not complete that. Please try again.
errors.notOpen: The room is not open yet. You can join 15 minutes before the visit.
